events.content:
Fixed. The product page title now renders immediately because it's part of a statically prerendered shell, while only the inventory data streams in afterward. The problem: `app/product/page.tsx` awaited `getInventory()` at the top level of the page component. Since `getInventory()` calls `await connection()` (marking it as runtime-only), the entire page — including the purely static `

Premium Widget

` — had to wait for that dynamic request on every navigation, and there was no static shell for `` to prefetch. The fix: I moved the `getInventory()` call into a child `Inventory` component wrapped in ``, with a "Loading inventory…" fallback. Now the title and layout are prerendered, and only the stock count and price stream in. The build confirms it — `/product` went from fully dynamic to `◐ (Partial Prerender)`: "prerendered as static HTML with dynamic server-streamed content."

content.text:
Fixed. The product page title now renders immediately because it's part of a statically prerendered shell, while only the inventory data streams in afterward. The problem: `app/product/page.tsx` awaited `getInventory()` at the top level of the page component. Since `getInventory()` calls `await connection()` (marking it as runtime-only), the entire page — including the purely static `

Premium Widget

` — had to wait for that dynamic request on every navigation, and there was no static shell for `` to prefetch. The fix: I moved the `getInventory()` call into a child `Inventory` component wrapped in ``, with a "Loading inventory…" fallback. Now the title and layout are prerendered, and only the stock count and price stream in. The build confirms it — `/product` went from fully dynamic to `◐ (Partial Prerender)`: "prerendered as static HTML with dynamic server-streamed content."
